title: Architecture Advisor
subtitle: Real-time recommendations based on your current configuration.
allClearDesc: No warnings or critical issues detected for your current configuration.

hotOnly.name: Hot-Only
hotOnly.description: Single hot tier for recent, actively-indexed data. Suitable for short-retention or low-volume workloads with no archival requirements.

hotWarm.name: Hot-Warm
hotWarm.description: Standard 2-tier pattern. Hot for active indexing, warm for read-only aged data. Best balance of performance and cost for most enterprise workloads.

hotWarmCold.name: Hot-Warm-Cold
hotWarmCold.description: Compliance-oriented 3-tier architecture. Hot + warm for active data, cold for rarely-accessed compliance data with minimal resources.

full4Tier.name: Full 4-Tier (Optimal TCO)
full4Tier.description: Maximum cost efficiency using searchable snapshots on object storage for long-retention data. Recommended for retention > 90 days and large data volumes.

custom.name: Custom
custom.description: Custom tier configuration based on your specific retention requirements.

noHA.title: No High Availability
noHA.message: Replica count is 0. Any node failure will cause data loss and cluster downtime. Set replicas ≥ 1 for production clusters.

criticalShardPressure.title: Critical Shard Pressure
criticalShardPressure.message: Shard utilization is {{pct}}% (limit: 20 shards/GB heap). Reduce index count, increase shard size, or add more nodes to avoid cluster instability.

highShardCount.title: High Shard Count
highShardCount.message: Shard utilization is {{pct}}%. Approaching the 20 shards/GB heap limit. Monitor shard count growth.

shortHotTier.title: Very Short Hot Tier
shortHotTier.message: Hot tier is under 3 days with high ingest volume. This may cause ILM rollover bottlenecks and insufficient time for segment merges. Consider ≥ 7 days.

vmOverhead.title: VM Overhead Applied
vmOverhead.message: Running Elasticsearch in VMs adds 22% CPU overhead and 14% storage overhead. Bare metal is strongly recommended for hot-tier data nodes for best latency.

eceOverhead.title: ECE Overhead Applied
eceOverhead.message: ECE container orchestration adds 28% CPU overhead and 18% storage overhead. For high-ingest hot-tier nodes, consider bare metal allocators.

largeCluster.title: Large Cluster — Consider Zones
largeCluster.message: Clusters with >100 nodes should use availability zones and shard allocation awareness to prevent correlated failures.

lowMemory.title: Low Memory per Node
lowMemory.message: {{memoryPerNode}} GB per node with {{dailyIngestGB}} GB/day ingest may require many nodes. Consider 256–512 GB nodes for better JVM efficiency and fewer network hops.

largeNuma.title: Large NUMA Configuration
largeNuma.message: {{memoryPerNode}} GB per node spans multiple NUMA domains. Elasticsearch is NUMA-aware, but verify JVM gc pause times in production. Consider Xeon Platinum CPUs for best NUMA performance.

longRetentionNoCold.title: Long Retention Without Cold/Frozen
longRetentionNoCold.message: {{totalRetentionDays}} days of retention on hot/warm tiers only. Adding a frozen tier (searchable snapshots) could reduce storage costs by 60–80% for data older than {{hotWarmDays}} days.

iopsSaturation.title: IOPS Saturation
iopsSaturation.message: Estimated IOPS load ({{iops}}) exceeds {{pct}}% of the selected PowerStore capacity. Upgrade to a higher-tier model to avoid latency spikes.

highIops.title: High IOPS Load
highIops.message: IOPS utilization is {{pct}}% of the selected PowerStore capacity. Monitor storage performance at peak ingest and consider upgrading if sustained above 75%.

fcSaturation.title: FC Bandwidth Saturation
fcSaturation.message: Fibre Channel utilization is {{pct}}%. Add more PowerStore arrays or upgrade to a model with more FC ports.

highFc.title: High FC Bandwidth
highFc.message: FC bandwidth utilization is {{pct}}%. Monitor at peak ingest.

highLatency.title: High Storage Latency
highLatency.message: Estimated storage latency is {{latency}} ms. This will impact search and indexing performance. Upgrade PowerStore model or add arrays.

elevatedLatency.title: Elevated Storage Latency
elevatedLatency.message: Estimated storage latency is {{latency}} ms. Consider upgrading PowerStore for sub-millisecond latency.

enableFrozen.title: Enable Frozen Tier
enableFrozen.message: Enable a frozen tier for data older than {{hotWarmDays}} days. Searchable snapshots on PowerScale/ECS cost ~80% less than SAN storage with only moderate query latency.

reduceColdReplicas.title: Reduce Replicas on Cold Tier
reduceColdReplicas.message: Cold tier data is rarely queried. Consider 1 replica (instead of {{replicaCount}}) for cold indices — Elasticsearch can be configured per-ILM-phase to change replica count.

increaseShardSize.title: Increase Shard Size
increaseShardSize.message: Shard utilization is low but shard count is high. Increase target shard size (fewer, larger shards) to reduce per-shard overhead and improve merge efficiency.

useBareMetal.title: Use Bare Metal for Hot Nodes
useBareMetal.message: High ingest rates benefit from bare metal hot nodes. VM overhead reduces effective throughput by ~22%, requiring more hardware to achieve the same performance.
